name: Empresaria Group plc
summary: Empresaria Group plc provides staffing and recruitment services in the United Kingdom, Continental Europe, the Asia Pacific, and the Americas. It offers permanent, temporary and contract, executive search, offshore recruitment, and recruitment process outsourcing services, as well as bespoke solutions that helps to meet the ever-evolving needs of clients and candidates. The company serves professional sector under the Ball and Hoolahan, Become Recruitment, Greycoat, Lumleys, LMA Recruitment, McCall, Monroe Consulting Group, Rishworth Aviation brands; IT sector under the ConSol and Skillhouse brands; healthcare sector under the Medical Recruitment Strategies and Medikumppani brands; property, construction, and engineering sector under the Teamssourcing brand; commercial sector under the Alternattiva, Fines Toyko, Solimano, and headway brands; Offshore Recruitment sector under the Ims group, ims PEOPLE, ims DATAWISE, ims DECIMAL, ims ONEWORLD, and bw&p brands. Empresaria Group plc was founded in 1996 and is based in Crawley, the United Kingdom.
